description.value: Aspiring Sorcerer (d6 hit die). Grants a bonus feat at Child level 2, one skill and one saving throw proficiency at level 3, and one weapon or shield proficiency at level 5. Lost on graduation except where noted (§ 5.4, § 5.6, § 5.8).

advFeatPick00000.title: Knack Bonus Feat
advFeatPick00000.hint: Choose one: Magic Initiate: Sorcerer or Metamagic Adept. The Prepare Knack Feats setup workflow populates the pool with the correct UUIDs from your enabled compendia; until that runs, drag in a feat manually.

advSkillOne00000.title: Mentor's Knowledge (Skill)
advSkillOne00000.hint: Choose one skill proficiency from the Sorcerer skill list.

advSaveOne000000.title: Mentor's Knowledge (Save)
advSaveOne000000.hint: Choose one saving throw proficiency from the Sorcerer class list.

advWeaponOne0000.title: Trade Skill (Weapon / Shield)
advWeaponOne0000.hint: Choose one weapon or shield proficiency from the Sorcerer class list. Lost on graduation.
